signed_rows.behavior: a write that OpenViking answers with a lock-timeout 409 twice and then 200 succeeds within the same event, with no failed event logged
signed_rows.fails_when: the event fails, is NAKed, or the write is sent fewer than three times

signed_rows.behavior: a 409 that is not a lock timeout, and a lock timeout that persists past the retry limit, still fail the event
signed_rows.fails_when: either case is reported as success or retried without bound

signed_rows.behavior: a retry waiting out its backoff holds no MaxInFlight slot
signed_rows.fails_when: while one request sleeps between lock-conflict retries, another request cannot take the only slot

signed_rows.behavior: both roots pin ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1, the module tests and vet pass, and the repo gates pass
signed_rows.fails_when: either ov_sync_consumer_image line names another tag, or the module tests, vet or just pre_commit fail
signed_rows.command: grep -q 'ov_sync_consumer_image *= "ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1"' deployments/applications/services.tf && grep -q 'ov_sync_consumer_image *= "ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1"' deployments/infrastructure/services.tf && just -f applications/ov-sync-consumer/justfile test && just pre_commit

signed_rows.behavior: after the operator releases v0.1.1 and applies, a burst sync logs no 'event failed' line caused by a lock-timeout 409
signed_rows.fails_when: the consumer log shows such a line during a sync
